description.narrative: Basic needs of the poor and vulnerable, especially women and children, supported

Food insecurity prevented during the COVID-19 outbreak for at least 240,500 poor people, including 53% women and girls Progress/Status: Assessment will be included in the PCR. Data Source: MLSP periodic FSP reports (2020), and knowledge and support TA impact assessment (2021) Target value: 240,500 Actual value:

At least 1.12 million children (50% girls) registered in the Integrated Household Database receive timely CMP benefits (March 2020 baseline, regular CMP: 1,107,130 children Progress/Status: Assessment will be included in the PCR. Data Source: MOF bank transfer documentation (2020), and MLSP Integrated Household Database (2020) Baseline value: 1,107,130
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Child-targeted income support increased Indicator: CMP monthly benefit level increased to MNT100,000 per child for 6 months Achievement: MNT100,000 Progress/Status: CMP monthly benefit level increased to MNT100,000 per child for 6 months April to September 2020 and later extended for a further 3 months October to December 2020 (ADB financing covered 5 months, no claim for July 2020) Data Source: Government resolution on CMP benefit increase (2020) Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: MNT20,000 Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: MNT20,000 Target year: 2021 Target value: MNT100,000 Actual value: MNT100,000

Output: Poverty-targeted food support increased Indicator: Delivery of higher value food vouchers or e-cards expands access to 10 staple food items for at least 44,000 of the poorest households, of which 20.5% are headed by women, and within which 53% of beneficiaries are women and girls (March 2020 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Actual data to be included in the PCR. Data Source: MLSP periodic FSP reports (2020), and knowledge and support TA impact assessment (2021) Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2021 Target value: 44,000

Output: Poverty-targeted food support increased Indicator: FSP monthly benefit level increased to MNT32,000 per adult and MNT16,000 per child for 5 months (March 2020 baseline: regular FSP benefit of MNT16,000 per month for adults, MNT8,000 per month for children) Achievement: MNT32,000 Progress/Status: FSP monthly benefit level increased to MNT32,000 per adult and MNT16,000 per child for 5 months May to September 2020. Data Source: MLSP ministerial order on FSP increase (2020) Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: MNT16,000 Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: MNT16,000 Target year: 2021 Target value: MNT32,000 Actual value: MNT32,000
